batch: 2026-09-09 9 tools from 'These Websites Give Designers an Unfair Advantage'

items.title: Product Hunt
items.description: Launch feed for new tools. Filter to design, sort by top rated, skip the hype cycle.

items.title: Fontbrief
items.description: Search type by personality, not name: warm or cold, loud or discreet. 400 curated faces.

items.title: Palitra
items.description: Type a word, get palettes pulled from matching images. Fast read on a niche's color norms.

items.title: Media Cheat Sheet
items.description: Every platform's image and video sizes on one page, kept current. Stop googling story dimensions.

items.title: Streamline
items.description: Vast icon and illustration sets in matched styles. Free tier is decent, Pro is where the depth is.

items.title: Branding Style Guides
items.description: Archive of real brand manuals, Apple to Citroën. See how the big ones structure a system.

items.title: Design Spells
items.description: Micro-interactions, easter eggs and 404s that make software feel alive. Delight, catalogued.

items.title: Growth.Design Psychology
items.description: Cognitive biases and UX principles, each tied to a case study. The why behind the patterns.

items.title: toools.design
items.description: Directory of every design resource you half remember, tagged free or paid. The meta-library.
